subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open recovery PR, require a fresh live reproduction first, or define a narrower current-main WebChat reconnect contract before further automation?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses UI state, Gateway active-run projection, session persistence, and restart semantics; source review shows partial fixes but not enough proof to pick the final contract automatically.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can preserve the useful recovery intent while using the current filtered active-run and session lifecycle helpers with live WebChat proof.

options.title: Ask for live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open but require redacted current-main WSL2/macOS WebChat logs or recording before selecting the final fix shape.

options.title: Wait on the open PR
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and prove the related PR before deciding whether it should own the remaining work.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can preserve the useful recovery intent while using the current filtered active-run and session lifecycle helpers with live WebChat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history places Peter on the refactored WebChat run lifecycle and Gateway session active-run surfaces that determine the final contract.
